fusions.name: Unruffled Release
fusions.desc: Fires an arrow that deals 28 water damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Soaked] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Skimming Low
fusions.desc: Skims a fan of arrows 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 7 water damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 7% for every tenth of your health you have lost (max 35%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Steady Under Fire
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your crit chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
